description: EEPROM images made by the image generator, which the inspector's tests read, so that they need no Python.
Each image is the Intel HEX file of its data model and platform settings, with the default base address and fill (0x0, 0xFF).
Where 'endianness' is given, it replaces that of the platform settings.
tools/eeprom_image_gen/test_eeprom_image_gen.py fails if an image is stale. Regenerate them with: uv run ./tools/eeprom_image_gen/make_image_vectors.py
